newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Gutnick silent on possible takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Gutnick silent on possible takeover bid.

text.p: Australian mining magnate Joe Gutnick on Tuesday declined to confirm or deny rumours his Great Central Mines NL gold company was about to be acquired by Canada's Barrick Corp.
Investment dealers attending the annual Diggers and Dealers mine conference in this mining centre have speculated Barrick would seek to acquire Great Central in the next few days.
"It's not the forum here to fuel or defuel any type of speculation," Gutnick said.
Great Central mines the rich Bronzewing and Jundee gold deposits in the Yandal Belt zone of Western Australia.
In the quarter ended June 30, 1997, Great Central yielded 106,981 ounces at an average cash cost of A$293 an ounce, company figures show.
Proved and probable reserves stand at 4.87 million ounces, the company has said.
